title.en: Forests and the Politics of Environmental Transformation
title.zh: 中国林业：森林与环境改造的政治

summary.en: A discussion of forest destruction and afforestation in China, the organization of forestry work, and how local cases can reshape broader historical interpretations.
summary.zh: 从毁林与造林的关系切入，讨论林业劳动的组织，以及局部案例如何修正更广泛的历史解释。

en: What did it mean to conquer nature in a particular forestry project?
How did expertise, administrative priorities, and everyday needs interact?
What evidence connects local cases with broader historical claims?
zh: 具体林业项目中的“征服自然”意味着什么？
专业知识、行政目标与日常需求如何相互作用？
局部案例与总体历史解释之间需要怎样的证据？

title.en: China’s Constitution: Formation and Political Practice
title.zh: 中国宪法：制度形成与政治实践

summary.en: An introductory discussion of what China’s constitution does, approached through the formation of political institutions. The Dual State model provided a starting point for discussion.
summary.zh: 从政治发生学的视角，初步理解中国宪法在做什么，并以 Dual State 模型作为讨论的起点。

time.zh: 晚 7–8 点 · 太平洋时间

location.zh: EAL Meeting Room（东亚图书馆会议室）

title.en: A Conversation with Laura Wen-yu Young
title.zh: 与 Laura Wen-yu Young 对谈

time.zh: 晚 7–8 点 · 太平洋时间

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

summary.en: An informal conversation about legal education and careers in law, with guest remarks followed by open discussion.
summary.zh: 围绕法律教育与职业经历的轻松对谈，嘉宾分享后开放讨论。

title.en: Metaphysics Across Cultures: Daoism, Aristotle, Kant, and Kafka
title.zh: 形而上学：道家、亚里士多德、康德与卡夫卡

summary.en: Odradek Zhang led a discussion of metaphysical questions across Daoist thought, the philosophies of Aristotle and Kant, and Kafka’s fiction.
summary.zh: 以道家思想、亚里士多德与康德的哲学和卡夫卡的文学作品为切入点，比较不同传统如何提出和处理形而上学问题。

title.en: Building a Digital Archive from San Francisco’s Chee Kung Tong Records
title.zh: 旧金山致公堂档案数字化

summary.en: The discussion focused on a digital archive built from the records of the Chee Kung Tong’s San Francisco lodge. The project combines a searchable catalog with a map and timeline for exploring the records by place and date.
summary.zh: 讨论以旧金山致公堂堂口的档案为基础，介绍如何将这些材料整理成可检索的数字档案。项目将档案目录与地图、时间轴结合，便于按地点和年代查阅相关记录。

time.zh: 晚 7–9 点 · 太平洋时间

title.en: Chinese Opera and Male Performers of Female Roles in the Ming and Qing Dynasties
title.zh: 明清的戏曲与优伶文化

summary.en: David Gong will examine the culture of Chinese opera in the Ming and Qing dynasties, focusing on male performers who played female roles.
summary.zh: 从男演员扮演女性角色的舞台实践切入，讨论明清戏曲中的优伶及其所处的演出文化。

title.en: Translating Ancestral Leaves: A Family Journey through Chinese History
title.zh: 翻译《叶：百年动荡中的一个中国家庭》

summary.en: Fanzhi Meng will discuss his experience co-translating historian Joseph W. Esherick’s Ancestral Leaves: A Family Journey through Chinese History into Chinese. The book follows generations of the Ye family, tracing how political and social change shaped their lives from the late Qing through the Republican era and into the People’s Republic.
summary.zh: 孟繁之将分享他参与翻译历史学家周锡瑞《叶：百年动荡中的一个中国家庭》的经历。这部著作追溯叶氏家族几代人的生活，呈现从晚清、民国到中华人民共和国成立后的社会与政治变迁如何影响一个家庭。

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

title.en: Book Talk with Liu Zongkun: Lives Remembered and Roads Traveled

time.zh: 下午 2–4 点 · 太平洋时间

summary.en: Writer and Texas attorney Liu Zongkun discusses his essay collection, published by 1 Plus Books in 2026. The essays revisit people he knew in China, met over two decades in Texas, and encountered while walking and cycling abroad. Their stories raise a question familiar to many who have moved away: what makes a place home?
summary.zh: 旅美律师、作家刘宗坤分享散文集《异乡故人》（壹嘉出版，2026）。书中写到中国故乡的亲友师长、移居得克萨斯二十余年间结识的人，以及徒步与骑行途中偶遇的陌生人。作者借这些人物故事，回望移居经历，追问故乡与归属的意义。

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室
